deploy_command:
import ctypes,os,subprocess,sys
f=ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetShortPathNameW
f.argtypes=[ctypes.c_wchar_p,ctypes.c_wchar_p,ctypes.c_uint32]
f.restype=ctypes.c_uint32
def short_path(path):
 b=ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(32768)
 n=f(path,b,len(b))
 short=b.value
 if short.startswith(chr(92)*2+'?'+chr(92)): short=short[4:]
 assert n and os.path.samefile(path,short), 'Candidate path mismatch'
 return short
raise SystemExit(subprocess.call([sys.executable,'scripts/cloudflare_release.py','publish','--artifact',short_path(sys.argv[1])],cwd=short_path(os.getcwd())))
